details: The Federal Reserve's latest Financial Stability Report indicates growing concerns about artificial intelligence (AI) within the financial system. Fifty percent of surveyed market participants now view AI as a potential shock, a significant increase from 30% previously, positioning AI among the top risks for the next 12 to 18 months.
title: Fed Report Highlights Rising AI Concerns for Financial Stability

details: Geopolitical tensions, notably concerning the US and Iran and the reported rejection of a peace plan by former President Trump, are negatively impacting financial markets. This uncertainty has contributed to a decline in cryptocurrency prices, with Bitcoin sliding towards $80,000.
title: US-Iran Tensions Weigh on Crypto Sentiment, Bitcoin Slides

details: Efforts to finalize the US CLARITY Act, a bill aimed at providing regulatory clarity for digital assets, are intensifying. A significant point of contention remains the treatment of stablecoin rewards, with the American Bankers Association advocating for tighter limits ahead of a crucial Senate committee vote. The long-term outlook for clearer regulations is seen as positive for institutional crypto adoption.
title: US CLARITY Act Progresses Amid Stablecoin Reward Debate

details: The cryptocurrency market is witnessing increased altcoin rotation, evidenced by a decline in Bitcoin dominance and a rebound in the ETH/BTC ratio. This suggests a potential shift of capital from Bitcoin into altcoins, expanding the market beyond just the leading cryptocurrency. USDT dominance has also fallen, indicating capital reallocation rather than an exit from risk assets.
title: Altcoin Rotation Accelerates as Bitcoin Dominance Dips

details: Cryptocurrency exchange Coinbase announced a net loss of US$394 million in the first quarter, largely attributed to a US$482 million unrealized decline in its crypto investments. The company also experienced an hours-long outage caused by an overheating Amazon Web Services (AWS) data center.
title: Coinbase Reports $394M Q1 Loss, Faces AWS Outage
